fieldValues.title: P4: Structure
fieldValues.summary: Introduces Relation first in the Part; reduces ext:recommended-relations to one line; moves the directory-kind-scopes design note to rationale; restores the comparison table to 'When to edit in-place'; re-parents Semantic order (ruling R4). Applies ruling R2: Blueprint and Protocol move to Distribution, Addressability and Discovery move to Extensions. Concepts getting prose: Relation, Relation type definition, Semantic order, Semantic succession, Source reference.
fieldValues.body:
Part unit from the read-through (§4, unit P4; findings §2 Part 4). Depended on P3.

Ruling R2: re-parented Blueprint and Protocol from Structure to Distribution; Addressability and Discovery from Structure to Extensions. Ruling R4 (Door 1): re-parented the stranded Semantic order mechanism under its concept. Re-parented the edit-in-place comparison table under its design-note (was a stray leaf in the Foundation Group (Core) reference dump). Reduced ext:recommended-relations to one line.

Did NOT land: Relation first in the Part. Same tool gap as P2/P3 (srs-rust#1130); its fix (srs-rust PR #1131, build.414) shipped just after this unit's non-ordering work was underway. Polled origin/master's pin for 40 minutes (19:07-19:47 UTC) for the expected parallel pin-bump PR; it never landed in that window (pin stayed at build.399). Shipped without the reorder per ruling A (no new precedes edge). A future unit can add ordering.memberOrder to part-structure once the pin advances.

Left in place, filed the-greenman/srs#841 (sub-issue of #580) instead of a workaround: design-notes/046 (directory-kind-scopes) cannot be excluded from the main narrative while staying in the rationale projection — no such mechanism exists.

New forward reference (Composition depends-on Discovery) is a direct, foreseen consequence of the R2 move; allowlisted in all three order-check allowlists citing #805.

PR: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/842 (merged, 2026-09-27T20:00:22Z).
